role.value: APPLY — the Academy ownership doctrine applied to one dated announcement (Alphabet Q3 2025: Gemini 650M monthly users). INTRODUCE (teaching the ownership doctrine from zero) was considered and rejected in the record: that is the Toaster song's and Lesson 1's job; this lane reports a fact and applies the doctrine. Payoff schedule recorded with the role (DR-ROLE): the level lands first (L2), velocity re-earns attention (L3: 400M → 650M in five months), the turn states the mechanism plainly at L4 (walls / rules / memory — not theirs), L5 concedes the model's magnificence and names the room's owner, and L6 cashes the metaphor — 650 million guests, the house not theirs. The spoken ask (L7) and the bridge then spend the conviction the payoff earned.

story_structure.value: The House fills up (lane structure, named): one app's count (L2), its velocity (L3), then the walls around every one of those users (L4), then the house named (L5–L6). Villain (N-06), named: The Landlord's Memory — (1) what the model remembers about you is kept inside Google's walls, on Google's terms: it serves the house, not the guest; (2) a guest who leaves takes nothing with them: the familiarity they built is not portable. (The dead solution is named by L4's shape: choosing the OTHER landlord — SOA-01's box — changes the wallpaper, not the tenancy.) Intended feeling: awe at the arrival rate, then the quiet reframe — a crowd that size, and every one of them a guest. The ONE vivid detail (N-03): a quarter of a billion people arriving in under half a year — a migration, not a growth curve.
